name: SonicBridge
subtitle: A production release for connected listening.
description: SonicBridge is a multi-platform audio streaming solution connecting Android phones, Android TV, and web experiences. Built around local-network discovery, device communication, and low-latency audio delivery, the project explores seamless audio experiences across connected devices.
problem: Make a connected listening experience feel immediate and dependable across the devices people already own, while keeping local device communication understandable and resilient.
focus: SonicBridge is a production engineering project spanning Android, Android TV, and a separately deployed web application.

approach.name: Discover
approach.detail: Find and identify compatible devices on the local network before establishing a session.

approach.name: Connect
approach.detail: Manage socket-based communication, connection state, and reconnect paths between Android devices.

approach.name: Stream
approach.detail: Move captured audio through the streaming pipeline and play it on Android with AudioTrack.

approach.name: Release
approach.detail: Ship Android and Android TV builds through Google Play and deploy the independent web experience on Vercel.

why: The architecture keeps native device communication on the local network while presenting the web experience as its own independently deployed platform.
related: SonicBridge demonstrates how careful device identity, connection management, and audio pipeline design can turn a systems problem into a polished product.
